tweaks.name: Turn on Game Mode
tweaks.description: Windows prioritises the game you're playing and holds back updates and background work while it runs.

tweaks.name: Turn off background game recording
tweaks.description: Stops Xbox Game Bar recording gameplay in the background, which costs GPU time every frame. You can still use other recorders like OBS or the NVIDIA app.

tweaks.name: Optimisations for windowed games
tweaks.description: DirectX 10/11 games in windowed and borderless mode use the faster flip presentation model, for lower latency.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.description: The GPU schedules its own memory. Needed for DLSS Frame Generation. Helps on some PCs, does nothing on others.

tweaks.name: High Performance power plan
tweaks.description: The CPU stays at high clocks instead of ramping up when a game needs it. Uses more power, and laptops run warmer.

tweaks.name: Turn off Memory Integrity
tweaks.description: Memory Integrity (Core Isolation) costs about 5% FPS in many games; Microsoft itself suggests turning it off for gaming. It's a security feature, so you lose some protection against malicious drivers.

tweaks.name: Turn off fullscreen optimisations
tweaks.description: Games set to fullscreen run in true exclusive fullscreen. Can lower input lag in older DirectX 9/11 games; on Windows 11 often no difference, and Alt+Tab gets slower. Test it in your games.

tweaks.name: Keep the graphics card's connection awake
tweaks.description: Turns off PCI Express power saving, so the GPU and NVMe drives never wait to wake up their connection. Removes small stutters. Uses a little more power.

tweaks.name: Higher priority for games
tweaks.description: Raises the priority Windows' multimedia scheduler gives games (CPU and disk). Only affects games that use the scheduler, so the effect is small, but it's harmless.

tweaks.name: Reserve less CPU for background tasks
tweaks.description: Windows normally holds back 20% of CPU time for background work while media or games run. This lowers it to 10%.

tweaks.name: Turn off power throttling
tweaks.description: Stops Windows slowing down apps in the background, so Discord, OBS and voice chat stay smooth while you play. On laptops, battery drains a bit faster.

tweaks.name: Keep the CPU at full speed when plugged in
tweaks.description: Sets the minimum CPU state to 100% on the current power plan, so it never has to ramp up from idle speed. Uses more power at idle.

tweaks.name: Faster menus
tweaks.description: Menus open after 20 ms instead of 400 ms when you hover over them.

tweaks.name: Turn off mouse acceleration
tweaks.description: Turns off 'Enhance pointer precision', so the same hand movement always moves the cursor the same distance. Essential for consistent aim.

tweaks.name: Set Windows pointer speed to 1:1
tweaks.description: Puts the Windows sensitivity slider on 6/11, the only setting where Windows doesn't skip or add pixels. Set your speed with your mouse's DPI instead. Changes how fast your cursor feels.

tweaks.name: Stop USB devices going to sleep
tweaks.description: Turns off USB selective suspend, so your mouse, keyboard and headset never fall asleep and lag on the first movement or key press.

tweaks.name: Fastest key repeat
tweaks.description: A held key starts repeating sooner and repeats faster. Makes holding keys (backspace, arrows, movement in some games) feel snappier.

tweaks.name: Turn off the Sticky Keys popup
tweaks.description: Pressing Shift five times mid-game no longer pops up Sticky Keys and kicks you out of the game.

tweaks.name: Turn off the Filter Keys popup
tweaks.description: Holding Right Shift for 8 seconds no longer turns on Filter Keys, which ignores quick key presses and adds delay.

tweaks.name: Turn off the Toggle Keys popup
tweaks.description: Holding Num Lock for 5 seconds no longer pops up the Toggle Keys prompt.

tweaks.name: Stop Alt+Shift switching keyboard language
tweaks.description: Alt+Shift and Ctrl+Shift no longer change your keyboard language by accident mid-game. You can still switch with Windows key + Space.

tweaks.name: Turn off hibernation and Fast Startup
tweaks.description: Deletes the hibernation file (often 10 GB or more) and turns off Fast Startup, which can keep drivers in a bad state between restarts. Boot takes a few seconds longer, and laptops can't hibernate.

tweaks.name: Stop hard drives sleeping
tweaks.description: Hard drives no longer spin down, which causes a freeze of a few seconds when they spin back up. No effect on SSDs.

tweaks.name: No surprise restarts from Windows Update
tweaks.description: Windows won't restart on its own to install updates while you're signed in. You restart when it suits you.

tweaks.name: Stop uploading updates to other PCs
tweaks.description: Windows stops sharing update files with other PCs over the internet, so it doesn't use your upload while you play.

tweaks.name: Remove the startup app delay
tweaks.description: Windows waits about 10 seconds after you sign in before starting startup apps. This removes the wait.

tweaks.name: Turn off transparency effects
tweaks.description: Turns off the see-through blur on the taskbar, Start and windows. Saves a little GPU time on weaker PCs.

tweaks.name: Turn off window animations
tweaks.description: Windows open, close and minimise instantly instead of animating. Makes the PC feel faster.

tweaks.name: Stop Store apps running in the background
tweaks.description: Microsoft Store apps can't run when they're closed. Saves memory and CPU. Some of them (Phone Link, Mail, Xbox app) won't send notifications while closed.

tweaks.name: Turn off search indexing
tweaks.description: Stops Windows constantly scanning your files to build the search index, which uses disk and CPU. Searching files in Start and File Explorer gets slower.

tweaks.name: Turn off the print service
tweaks.description: Stops the Print Spooler service. Only turn this on if you never print: printing won't work until you turn it back off.

tweaks.name: Turn off SysMain (Superfetch)
tweaks.description: SysMain preloads apps it expects you to open, which causes disk and memory churn mid-game. On a hard drive, app launches get a little slower.

tweaks.name: Turn off Copilot
tweaks.description: Turns off the Windows Copilot sidebar by policy. On newer builds Copilot is a normal app; uninstall it in Settings > Apps.

tweaks.name: Turn off Widgets
tweaks.description: The news and weather panel stops loading in the background.

tweaks.name: Keep Bing out of Start search
tweaks.description: Start searches your PC and nothing else, so it's faster and never opens a browser by accident.

tweaks.name: Turn off search highlights
tweaks.description: Removes the daily pictures and trending topics from the search box and Start search.

tweaks.name: Turn off Recall
tweaks.description: Stops Windows taking periodic snapshots of your screen on Copilot+ PCs. Does nothing on other machines.

tweaks.name: Stop Edge running when it's closed
tweaks.description: Turns off Startup Boost and background mode. Edge will show 'managed by your organisation' in its settings.

tweaks.name: Stop Windows installing suggested apps
tweaks.description: Windows stops silently installing sponsored apps and games (like Candy Crush) on your PC.

tweaks.name: Turn off tips and suggestions
tweaks.description: No more suggestions in Start, Settings and pop-up tips about Windows features.

tweaks.name: Turn off lock screen ads and fun facts
tweaks.description: Removes the tips, fun facts and promotions shown on the lock screen.

tweaks.name: Stop 'Finish setting up your PC' screens
tweaks.description: Windows stops showing the full-screen 'Let's finish setting up your device' prompts after updates.

tweaks.name: Turn off OneDrive
tweaks.description: Stops OneDrive syncing and running in the background. Only do this if you don't use OneDrive: files in it stop backing up.

tweaks.name: Send Microsoft the minimum diagnostic data
tweaks.description: Sets diagnostic data to the lowest level and turns off the Connected User Experiences service that uploads it.

tweaks.name: Turn off the advertising ID
tweaks.description: Apps can't use your advertising ID to show you personalised ads.

tweaks.name: Turn off activity history
tweaks.description: Windows stops recording which apps and files you open and uploading it to Microsoft.

tweaks.name: Turn off error reporting
tweaks.description: Windows stops collecting and sending crash reports, and stops filling your disk with report files.

tweaks.name: Turn off location for all apps
tweaks.description: No app can use your location. Turn it back off if you need maps or 'Find my device'.
